title: IHCL Q1 Results: Profit rises 18% YoY to Rs 390 crore, total income up 15%
description: Tata Group-backed IHCL reported its 17th consecutive record quarter, with Q1 FY27 net profit rising 18.5% and total income up 15%. Strong hotel performance, rapid expansion, acquisitions and growth businesses offset macro challenges, while the company maintained its double-digit revenue growth outlook.

title: ICICI Bank eyes $500 million dollar bond issue via GIFT City
description: ICICI Bank is close to raising at least $500 million through five-year dollar bonds via its GIFT City unit, leveraging the RBI’s concessional swap facility. The proceeds will support client financing, marking the lender’s first US dollar bond issuance in nearly a decade.

title: Anant Raj to demerge data centre arm into separately listed company
description: Anant Raj will demerge its data centre and cloud business into Ashok Cloud Pvt Ltd, creating a separately listed digital infrastructure company. The move aims to unlock shareholder value, support expansion to 307 MW by FY32 and strengthen its cloud services platform.

title: Powerful rally! This Wall Street AI winner with 500% share price jump is not your typical chip stock
description: GE Vernova has surged over 500% since its 2024 spin-off, emerging as a key AI infrastructure play. Investors are betting on rising electricity demand from data centres, boosting orders, backlog and guidance. Strong growth in power, electrification and gas turbines is driving the rally beyond traditional chip-focused AI stocks.

title: SEBI asks depositories to implement ISIN-level freeze framework for promoter holdings by Aug 1
description: Capital markets regulator SEBI on Tuesday asked depositories to put in place the operational framework and required system upgrades by August 1 to facilitate the implementation of the newly introduced ISIN-level freeze mechanism for promoter and promoter group holdings during share buybacks.

title: Sebi cancels registration of 11 research analysts for non-payment of renewal fee
description: On Tuesday, Sebi took a decisive step by canceling the registrations of eleven research analysts due to their failure to pay the required renewal fees for their certificates. Despite earlier notices issued, these entities did not respond, prompting the regulator to act under the Intermediaries Regulations of 2008. This measure seeks to deter potential misuse of expired registration credentials.

title: Sebi eases rules for mutual fund, SIF distributors with single certification exam
description: Sebi has launched a unified certification for mutual fund and Specialised Investment Fund distributors, known as the NISM Series V-D certification. This new credential streamlines the eligibility criteria for selling these products.

title: Global Markets: London Stock Exchange to launch round-the-clock trading next year
description: Starting in early 2027, the London Stock Exchange is set to unveil LSE 24, a pioneering venue designed for overnight trading of exchange-traded products. This initiative is a direct response to the increasing demand from international investors for expanded trading options. Although equities may be introduced on LSE 24 in the future, the main market will maintain its traditional hours.

title: US stocks today: Nasdaq surges 1% as chip stocks extend recovery; earnings in focus
